newsitem.title: CHINA: S.Korean foreign minister to visit China in May.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean foreign minister to visit China in May.

text.p: South Korean Foreign Minister Yoo Chong-ha is to visit China next week, a Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesman said on Thursday.
Yoo, visiting at the invitation of his Chinese counterpart Qian Qichen, would be in China from May 18 to 20, Foreign Minstry spokesman Shen Guofuang told a regular news briefing.

Qian's talks with Yoo would focus on bilateral issues as well as regional issues of mutual concern to China and South Korea, Shen said, but did not say whether the issue of North Korea would arise in the discussions.
"Qian will talk with him on issues in bilateral relations," Shen said. Yoo's visit would boost cooperation between China and South Korea, he said but gave no further details.

He did not say whether talks would touch on four-way talks proposed by the United States and South Korea and involving China and North Korea to defuse tensions on the Korean peninsula by replacing a fraying armistice with a formal peace treaty.
North Korea has yet to agree to the peace talks proposal.

North Korea told U.S. and South Korean negotiators in New York last month it would join the peace talks but its participation was conditional on large-scale food aid, the lifting of U.S. trade sanctions and diplomatic recognition.
